in_marathi.name: Vikaransh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who acts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikaransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikaransh means 'one who acts'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vikar' which means 'action' and 'ansh' which means 'a part'. This name signifies the one who takes action and leads from the front.
